environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on ECS Fargate. pgBouncer 1.22 configured with `disable_pqexec = 1` in the [pgbouncer] section, which rejects simple protocol queries (Q message) and only permits extended query protocol (Parse/Bind/Execute messages). The pg driver's `query()` method with string interpolation sends queries via the simple protocol (Q message), causing pgBouncer to terminate the connection with 'simple query not allowed' error before the SQL reaches PostgreSQL. Additionally, pgBouncer auth_type is set to `scram-sha-256` with `server_tls_sslmode = verify-full`. The ALB has an associated WAFv2 WebACL but it only contains AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet (not the SQLi ruleset), so the WAF is NOT the blocking control here.

config.pgbouncer_config:
pool_mode = transaction
max_client_conn = 100
default_pool_size = 20
disable_pqexec = 1
auth_type = scram-sha-256
server_tls_sslmode = verify-full
